messages:
Aisha (CSM): Quick heads-up 1 StratoIQ dedicated pool activation scheduled Tue 13:00 PST. Need final quota sign-off, autoscale window, and enablement invite.

Ethan (Infra): Can we confirm 13:00? There's GPU host maintenance earlier; prefer 13:00 to avoid overlap. Also need priming plan for KV/prefix caches.

Priya (Success Eng): 13:00 works. Suggested warmup: 30m steady baseline + 3x2m spikes. Baseline 100 rps, spikes to 400 rps. We'll validate KV hits and prefix cache behavior.

Noah (ML Eng): Model: stratoiq-v2 (q4_0). Expect ~7.6ms/token on p4d at batch_size=8, max_seq=1024. Suggest batch_size=8, kill-switch if GPU mem >85%.

Aisha (CSM): Customer also asked about SLA/KMS. Priya please cover SSO + KMS during enablement. Ethan, confirm fallback if OOM.

Ethan (Infra): Fallback: route to hosted-small variant (stratoiq-v2-slim) with higher latency. Autoscale policy (pseudo):
policy: util_percent | threshold:85 | scale_step:+1 | cooldown:120s | fallback: hosted-small
I'll enable prefix prepopulate.

Priya (Success Eng): Enablement invite sent to StratoIQ infra + devs for tomorrow 10:00 PST. Agenda: SSO, KMS, runbook, logs access, cost dashboard.

Aisha (CSM): Renewal risk note: flag if p95 >400ms or error_rate>1% during smoke. We'll capture perf + feedback within 24h.

Ethan (Infra): Load run plan: shadow at 13:05, official at 13:15. Local command:
./loadgen --target 100 --duration 1800 --burst 400 --model stratoiq-v2 --prefix-cache=true
Will post Prom links and flamegraphs after.

deploy-bot: Reminder - infra maintenance window 2026-04-12 06:00-08:00 UTC (eu-west nodes).

Noah (ML Eng): Tip: disable mixed-precision rollover for this run to stabilize memory. Capture KV hit rate metric.

Priya (Success Eng): Smoke checklist:
- Quota: 12k tokens/min reserved
- Warmup: prefix/KV seeded
- Autoscale: 85% GPU util threshold
- Fallbacks: hosted-small route validated
- KMS: customer key verified
- Observability: 7d retention for account logs

Aisha (CSM): Thanks. I'll own post-run feedback collection and send renewal health update if anything risky. ETA for results?

Ethan (Infra): Results posted ~13:45 PST. Prom dashboard: https://prom.example.com/stratoiq/run/1768401150 - uploading flamegraphs + summary shortly.

Priya (Success Eng): I'll collect qualitative runbook feedback from StratoIQ and log any enablement gaps.

Aisha (CSM): Tagging thread final pre-activation. :thumbsup:
